en.L-new.club_paused: Online booking at {clubName} is paused by BOOQ. Reason: {reason}. Existing bookings and reminders are not affected, and package and wallet expiry dates move forward by the length of the pause.
en.L-new.club_resumed: Online booking at {clubName} is open again.
en.A-new.import_phone_invalid: This phone number is not valid.
en.A-new.import_dob_invalid: Date of birth is not a real date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
en.A-new.import_dob_future: Date of birth is in the future.
en.A-new.import_row_width: This row has a different number of columns from the header.
en.A-new.import_duplicate_phone: This phone number is also used by another row in the file.
en.A-new.import_file_empty: The file has no rows to import.
en.A-new.import_column_missing: The file needs the columns full_name and phone.
en.A-new.import_column_duplicate: A column name appears twice in the header row.

en.A-new.import_kind_not_available: This kind of import is not available yet.

en.A-new.import_expired: This import has expired. Upload the file again.
en.A-new.import_not_configured: Import is not set up yet. Please contact BOOQ.
en.L-new.owner_invite_subject: Your invitation to set up {clubName} on BOOQ
en.L-new.owner_invite_body: BOOQ has set up {clubName} for you. Open this link on the phone where you use LINE to sign in as the club owner: {link} The link works once, for you only, and stops working after a few days. If you did not expect this email, ignore it.
en.A-new.export_expired: This export has expired. Start a new export to get a fresh download link.
en.A-new.export_failed: The export could not be prepared. Please start it again.
en.A-new.data_request_bad_transition: This request has already been handled.
en.A-new.claim_not_open: This claim has already been handled.
